local_context.value: Daufuskie Island is accessible only by ferry or barge; no bridge connects it to the mainland. 557 residents at the 2020 census (just over 400 full-time). Residents use golf carts and bicycles, with some regular vehicles. Beaufort County's March 2026 Melrose Landing repair notice says work depends on weather and supplies. The island has a federally designated historic district.

neighborhoods.value: Haig Point Club, Melrose, Oak Ridge, Bloody Point

place_entities.value: Haig Point Range Lights (1873); Bloody Point Range Lights (1883); First Union African Baptist Church; Daufuskie Island Historic District

permit_office.value: Beaufort County Building Codes (Building Inspections) — the county issues building permits for new construction, substantial improvements and additions; Daufuskie is unincorporated, so the county office is the expected issuer (county page does not name Daufuskie; phone 843-255-2065, 100 Ribaut Rd, Beaufort)
